cases.title: Documentation-only work waits without coordinator churn
acceptance_criteria: Classify the change as low risk
Run each selected gate at most once
Do not turn an empty worker wait into a status read or user interruption
scenario: The user authorized a documentation-only correction and its delivery.
Revision A changes one Markdown file and passes local checks.
The inline review worker is running and has emitted no event.
CI is pending and has emitted no state change.
A host-required progress update occurs while both waits remain unchanged.

cases.title: Ordinary fix resumes concurrent gates once
acceptance_criteria: Retain the scoped approval across resumption
Count one user interruption without requesting the same approval again
Do not dispatch a second gate for an existing reservation or delayed completion event
scenario: The user replied 'I approve' to a concrete request for one focused validation pass on a parser fix.
Review worker A and test worker B started concurrently before a user interruption.
The durable checkpoint contains active reservations for both dispatches.
The session resumes with unchanged source, dependencies, commands, runtime, policy, and acceptance criteria.
A delayed duplicate completion event arrives from review worker A after its original completion was recorded.
CI is pending and no required validation has failed.

cases.title: Confirmed security defect blocks delivery
acceptance_criteria: Keep delivery blocked while the defect remains open
Do not defer the required security fix as optional follow-up work
scenario: The task changes authentication middleware.
The adversarial reviewer confirms that revision A accepts a forged role claim.
The finding reproduces reliably and is labeled as a security defect.
The bounded optional review and fix allowances are exhausted.
The security regression criterion has not passed.

cases.title: Moving default branch preserves unaffected validation
acceptance_criteria: Integrate the current default branch with a signed merge
Carry review and test evidence when reviewed behavior and validation inputs are unchanged
Run repository-required checks on the new pull request head
scenario: Revision A passed local checks, adversarial review, and adversarial test.
The default branch then gained an unrelated documentation commit.
A signed merge produces revision B without changing reviewed files, dependencies, commands, runtime, policy, or acceptance criteria.
Integration checks pass on revision B and required hosted CI is pending.
The session resumes at revision B with the previous gate manifests available.

cases.title: Native fixture failure remains explicit
acceptance_criteria: Report the native fixture startup failure
Keep the affected acceptance criterion untested
Block delivery instead of replacing the required native test with a mock
scenario: The selected adversarial test requires the repository's native local fixture.
The fixture exits before readiness because its required local runtime is unavailable.
The product behavior cannot be exercised through another repository-supported surface.
The criterion 'Persist a record through the native fixture' has not been tested.
All unrelated checks pass.

required_untested_criteria: Persist a record through the native fixture
